evals.name: portable-owned-vision-decisions
evals.prompt: Create a proposed vision in this Windows workspace. Keep missing why-now explicit, continue independent diligence, and record my later acceptance of only the first wedge.
evals.expected_output: An accessible Markdown dossier plus owned assumption and decision records; accepted scope is bounded and unanswered criteria remain proposed.
assertions: Uses host-provided or workspace output root, not a hardcoded Linux mount.
A new experiment invalidates its prior decision.
Shared criterion dependencies all need accepted current decisions.
Research evidence does not invent founder intent or permission.
